Snapshots efficiently store only the changes made after the snapshot, making them ideal for data protection and recovery. Once activated, you need a preview key to consume this resource. Please reach out to Ng-fsx-cloudformation@netapp.com to get the key. To use this resource, you must first create the Link module.
